About Honeit | Interview Intelligence Built by Recruiters Log In Request a Demo Built by recruiters, for recruiters. Honeit was created by people who spent their careers in recruiting and talent acquisition, alongside the engineers who build for them. We built the platform we always wished we had: one that clears the busywork around every conversation, so recruiters can do what they do best and hiring managers get the full story behind every candidate. Request a Demo The Problem We Lived We knew there had to be a better way. The most important information in recruiting comes from a conversation: how a candidate answers, what they emphasize, and the context a recruiter picks up in real time. But too much of a recruiter s day goes to everything around it. The busywork eats the day Scheduling, note-taking, summaries, submissions, and chasing feedback pull time away from the actual conversation. Context gets flattened The signal from a great screening call is reduced to a few bullet points that lose what mattered most. The story fades in the handoff Passed through the org like a game of telephone, the best of the conversation is gone before the hiring manager hears it. Why We Built Honeit The tools were the problem, not the recruiters. We didn t come to this from the outside. Honeit was founded in 2014, out of Berkeley SkyDeck, by a team that had spent years as recruiters and talent leaders and years building the software those teams rely on. We lived the fragmented workflows and the lost context, and we kept arriving at the same conclusion: the problem was never the recruiters. It was the tools. So we built Honeit to protect the value of a recruiter s conversations. To capture what was actually said, handle the administrative work around it, and turn every interview into something clear enough to act on. Technology should make a recruiter s expertise go further, not stand in for it. What Changes Better tools for recruiters. Better data for hiring teams. For recruiters Time and clarity, back where they belong. When the busywork disappears, recruiters get their time back for the work that matters: talking with candidates, building relationships, and applying judgment no software can replace. For hiring teams The full story, not a thin summary. Because every conversation is captured and structured, hiring managers get the real answers, the context, and the evidence behind a recommendation, so they can decide faster and with more confidence.
